name: Quest Hotel and Conference Center Cebu
detail: After spending one night in the dormitory, I found the bed and room to feel even more spacious, and I made very convenient use of various facilities. I made a last-minute change to the breakfast dates during my two-night stay, and they accommodated it well, allowing me to efficiently manage my schedule. I didn't have shoes to use the gym, so I only looked around, but I made great use of the pool. It was convenient to borrow towels for free just by providing room numbers and other information, and the conditions were very good, making it comfortable. I also remember a cute 5-year-old child who swam confidently, even though they had never learned. The breakfast was somewhat different from my personal preference, but I had a pleasant morning thanks to the friendliness of the staff, including the one grilling bacon, the one serving tofu soup while sweating, and the one who constantly checked on my coffee. Additionally, the location of the accommodation was fantastic. I checked in after a meal at House of Lechon, and after checking out, I walked to Ayala Mall. It said no stopping when I called a Grab, but you can just call it and get in. Lastly, I want to mention that the two staff members who came out to the reception area with tablets to assist were incredibly kind. They showed consideration for my limited English and seemed genuinely eager to help with various things, treating me with endless kindness without any annoyance. I sincerely express my gratitude.

name: Mandarin Plaza Hotel
detail: It takes about 40 minutes from the airport. The staff is very kind and everyone greets you with a smile. There is a bathtub and a curtain, so it was nice that water didn't splash onto the toilet. They replenish the bottled water daily, and they also do bed making, garbage collection, and towel exchange. The pool is safe and secure to swim in, and they provide pool towels. It seemed like you could also borrow floaties. The location is good, with restaurants and a mall within walking distance. The hair dryer had a short operating time, so I went to dry my hair regularly. It would turn off when it got hot and wouldn't work until it cooled down. Shampoo, conditioner, and body soap are provided, and there is also a toothbrush.

name: Palette Cebu The Almonds Boutique Aparthotel Near University of Cebu
detail: The hotel was ideal for my business trip because it was easy to get to meetings, and I could work comfortably in the room without distractions. The Wi-Fi was reliable, the bed was comfortable, and the staff handled check-in and check-out quickly.

name: Seda Ayala Center Cebu City
detail: The location was great because it was very close to Ayala Mall! It was especially nice to be able to comfortably walk to the large shopping mall. The accommodation was overall chic and tidy, and most importantly, the bedding was really clean, making for a pleasant stay. The staff was also friendly and the service was good, so I was very satisfied during my stay. Since I had a late flight, I only stayed for half a night this time, but I would definitely want to visit again if I come to Cebu next time. I plan to stay for at least three nights then 😊 I would really recommend this accommodation to anyone looking for a place in Cebu because I was satisfied with the location, cleanliness, and service! I have a 100% intention to return💕

name: bai Hotel
detail: Hotel cleanliness Hotel facilities Superb food Amenities is excellent Spacious Parking area availability Curteous staff

name: Appleton Boutique Hotel Cebu
detail: The room was very spacious, clean, and well-maintained. The amenities included two bottles of water, rinse-in shampoo, soap, and a toothbrush set. There was also a hairdryer. Wifi was available, but it was very slow. The location was convenient with supermarkets and restaurants nearby. It was said that the airport transfer was free one way, so we were very grateful to be taken to the airport after checkout. However, even though it was a domestic flight, we had to arrive at the airport three hours early. Since our flight was at 7:35 AM, we had to leave at 4 AM, which left us with a lot of time at the airport. But I guess it’s better than being late?

name: Waterfront Cebu City Hotel and Casino
detail: The view from the window of a partially sea view room (the area around the hotel has many run-down buildings) wasn't that great, but the staff always greeted us when passing by, and they were considerate enough to interrupt their work in the garden to help carry our luggage. They refused when we tried to give them tips. I handed them a little something, saying it was just a gesture, and they weren't pushy about it. The private beach isn't suitable for swimming. The emphasis on the garden was really lovely. The prices were reasonable. It was convenient as there were many places to eat around. The restroom was very clean, and I would love to visit again.

name: Radisson Blu Cebu
detail: The outdoor pool was under construction and unavailable, but everything else was excellent. It would have been even better with a bathtub, but it was still worth it. It took less than 30 minutes to drive to the airport. The SM Mall was also just 1-2 minutes away. I plan to use this place again next time.

name: One Central Hotel
detail: We stayed for three nights. The location is very good, and both dining and sightseeing are within walking distance. The front desk is on the 9th floor, the same floor as the breakfast area. The front desk staff is very pleasant. The room is cleaned every day, and water and towels are replenished, which is perfect. They can also help you catch a taxi when you leave the hotel. The night pool is lovely (although the water isn't very clear). All the staff working there are cheerful and pleasant, making it a hotel that makes you want to stay again. I was worried about staying for three nights, but everything - the staff, breakfast, pool, and location - was great.

name: Seda Central Bloc Cebu City
detail: In Cebu, people usually go to beach resorts, but if you’re considering a city hotel, this one comes highly recommended. It's located in the clean IT Park, where you can enjoy infrastructure comparable to levels found in Korea, and the convenience of shopping at Ayala Mall, which connects on the 5th floor of the hotel. I stayed on the 8th floor, and I didn't experience the outdoor air conditioning noise mentioned in other reviews. However, during heavy rain, there was some noise from the raindrops, but it was only a couple of hours during my stay, so it wasn't a big deal. I did have a minor inconvenience with the shower drain; it wasn't draining smoothly due to an angle issue, but aside from that, everything was satisfactory. I’ve also stayed at the SEDA hotel in Ayala Center Mall, but this one was cleaner and more spacious. All the staff were friendly and greeted me with bright smiles, which made me feel good throughout my stay.
